== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Dreadgod]] weapons are powerful armaments created by [[Lindon]]. These tools possess significant spiritual weight and can be used to rival the strength of [[Monarchs]], provided the wielder possesses sufficient Authority{{!}}authority and parts of a [[Herald]]'s body. The weapons are capable of reacting to nearby threats, which can cause environmental effects like screaming air or crackling lightning. Specific examples include a blue, scaled bow with a lightning-infused string and swords crafted from the [[Weeping Dragon]]. As more of these weapons are produced, [[Lindon]]'s two-headed hammer, [[Genesis]], grows increasingly heavy and powerful. There is a desire to collect these items for the purpose of consuming minds to feed [[Dross]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Capable of launching volleys of arrows, these weapons are one of only two types on [[Cradle]] that can rival Li Markuth{{!}}Markuth's [[sword]]. While a person possessing a [[Herald]]'s body and the beginnings of Authority{{!}}authority can wield them, [[Lindon]] eventually comes to possess two such items. One of these weapons is a blue, [[scale]]-covered bow that [[Lindon]] presents to [[Larian]], which carries the spiritual weight of a [[Dreadgod]]. Furthermore, these weapons possess the ability to react when they sense threats.}}
